product.summary: Traversal is a platform that automates the incident investigation process for Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) through AI agents (Workers). Its proprietary Production World Model and Causal Search Engine simultaneously test multiple hypotheses to identify root causes and suggest fixes.
product.problem_statement: In modern microservice environments, when an incident occurs, SRE engineers manually track numerous alerts to find the cause, which takes a long time and is prone to human error.
product.solution: Traversal connects logs, metrics, traces, code change history, and runbooks to create a continuously updated map of the production environment. AI agents automatically investigate incidents and present root causes and evidence in Slack and other channels.
key_features: Traversal Workers: Automatically start investigation upon event occurrence.
Causal Search Engine: Parallel testing of thousands of hypotheses.
Alert Intelligence: Pre-filter noisy alerts.
Production Support: Engineers can ask production questions in natural language.
Code Resilience: Predict production impact before code changes.
Traversal MCP: Provide production information to coding agents.
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Core technology is causal machine learning (causal ML) and reinforcement learning, with the Production World Model modeling causal relationships across large-scale microservices and a hypothesis verification engine.
product.target_customer: Large engineering organizations (SRE teams). Customers: Nubank, Harvey, PepsiCo, DigitalOcean, Fortune 100 companies.
product.business_model: SaaS subscription-based (exact pricing model is undisclosed)

competitive_landscape.moat: Accumulated Production World Model data and causal ML algorithms, multi-platform integration experience. Secured capital through large investments from major VCs.
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: Traversal is positioned as an independent AI layer on top of observability tools, offering deeper causal analysis without being dependent on platform vendors like Datadog.

product.summary: Chemoproteomics combining mass spectrometry (DIA-MS) and AI to analyze drug binding across the whole proteome, enabling target discovery/validation and off-target (side effect) profiling. Products: target discovery platform Javelin, DIA analysis solution SynapSpec, biomedical DB Glance, and structure-based deep learning model Skeleton.
product.problem_statement: Target discovery and validation is the most uncertain stage in drug development. Existing lab-based validation is slow, and public data-driven AI models only make predictions without experimental validation. Off-target binding—drugs unintentionally binding to other proteins—causes toxicity and side effects, but there was no standard method to verify this at the whole-proteome level early in development.
product.solution: AI trains on experimental drug-protein binding data generated from in-house designed chemoproteomics experiments. Preprocessing with 'massive trypsinization' achieves coverage of over 5,000 proteins, and provides dose-response and binding site-level information within 4–6 weeks, simultaneously delivering on-target confirmation, off-target list, and safety assessment.
key_features: Javelin: AI-powered chemoproteomics target discovery platform — provides dose-response curves and peptide/domain-level binding resolution.
SynapSpec: Deep learning-optimized DIA mass spectrometry data analysis solution.
Glance: Biomedical database for target discovery and drug repurposing.
Skeleton: Model that uses 3D structure-based deep learning to optimize molecular structures.
Target profiling service: On-target confirmation + off-target and toxicity assessment report for submitted compounds.
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: DIA-MS mass spectrometry + 'massive trypsinization' pre-processing (simpler than limited proteolysis) + AI-based quantification (spectral deconvolution). The company claims higher resolution and sensitivity compared to existing methods like CETSA/TPP, DARTS, SPROX, and LiP-MS, emphasizing that it closes the 'prediction↔measurement' loop with experimental data.
product.target_customer: Pharma and biotech companies that have confirmed efficacy but lack target/off-target information (target profiling service), global big pharma targeting undruggable targets that are difficult to develop with existing methods, and partners for joint research and technology transfer.
product.business_model: Short-term: Generate cash flow through target profiling services. Mid-term: Joint research with big pharma and milestone payments (joint research with Takeda on cancer drugs). Long-term: Technology transfer and licensing of own pipeline (autoimmune BIMM-1, metabolic disease BIMM-6) with upfront+milestone+royalty structure.

product.summary: Liner is a source-based AI search and research platform. It started as a web highlighter in 2015 and pivoted to AI search in 2023. When users ask questions, it searches the web and academic data to provide answers with sentence-level citations. It offers dedicated agents like 'Liner Scholar' for academic research, 'Liner Write' for business document writing, and 'Liner Finance' for investment research.
product.problem_statement: Researchers and knowledge workers spend a lot of time finding reliable sources amid vast amounts of information. General-purpose AI chatbots like ChatGPT suffer from hallucinations and unverified information.
product.solution: Liner uses 10 years of accumulated user highlighting data as a search ranking signal to prioritize the most trusted sources. Each sentence shows citation links and key excerpts, allowing users to immediately verify the factual accuracy of the answer. It uses a self-developed search-optimized lightweight language model (SLM) and a component-based search LLM to improve accuracy.
key_features: Sentence-level source citations (link + quote + preview)
Scholar Mode: search based on a database of over 500 million academic articles
Deep Research: generates in-depth reports in an average of under 2 minutes
Fact-check: verifies the source of each sentence in the answer
Supports 4 languages (Korean, English, Chinese, Japanese)

product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Self-developed search/ranking algorithm and search-optimized SLM. 10 years of highlighting data from 14 million users used as search quality signals. Scores 93.5–95.3 on the OpenAI SimpleQA benchmark (top tier compared to competitors). Component-based architecture enables response times around 2 minutes (average 7x faster than ChatGPT, 4x faster than Perplexity).
product.target_customer: College students, graduate students, researchers (primary); knowledge workers, enterprise users (secondary). Over 60% of paid subscribers belong to US universities/research institutions.
product.business_model: B2C premium subscription (monthly/yearly plans) + B2B enterprise license (AX – AI Transformation). Sells enterprise search and enterprise intelligence products to corporate clients.
